```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(Seurat)
```

```{r}
targets::tar_load(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
x <- read.csv(file.path("data/sanjuan-pla_2013/41586_2013_BFnature12495_MOESM15_ESM.csv"))
sets <- ç %>% mutate(dir = ifelse(Ratio>0, "up", "down" ))%>%with(split(Symbol, dir))
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- AddModuleScore(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, features = sets)
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
            features = c("Cluster1", "Cluster2"),
            split.by = "sample.name")&
  RestoreLegend()&
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")

FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
            features = sets$up[sets$up %in% rownames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)],
            pt.size = 0.01,
            ncol = 6)&
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")&
  theme(title = element_text(size = 4),legend.position = "none")&
  theme_void()&NoLegend()

```
